cases: restored grants allow only trusted service execution; anonymous and customer-role RPC calls are denied
existing-account connection and retries preserve wallet identity; conflicting account links reject atomically
verified new-account activation creates one empty wallet; unverified canonical identity is rejected
checkout reservation debits once, survives exact retry, and rejects changed owner or amounts
unverified payment cannot earn; verified purchase earns whole eligible dollars exactly once and cannot be cancelled
partial and full verified merchandise refunds proportionally restore redemption and reverse earning once; stale/excess refunds reject
verified cancellation returns reserved Leaves once; released attempt cannot later settle or reserve again
purchase without redemption earns once; overspend and redemption beyond eligible merchandise reject
cash refund without merchandise allocation and changed payment verification cannot award new Leaves
bridge authentication denies untrusted callers and account history/quotes stay wallet-scoped
refund reversal creates separate debt with spendable zero and unchanged economic net; new overspending rejects and valid release repays debt
all synthetic account/order/ledger activity rolls back; historical row digests and financial totals remain exact

limits: Single-session isolated PostgreSQL17.5 WASM; no native concurrency claim.
